title: Korean BBQ restaurant serving beer and wine in Flushing

input.what: Korean BBQ restaurant serving beer and wine

assumptions: The company already exists (Northern Blvd BBQ LLC). Hires staff. Builds out the space. Puts up an exterior sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Certificate of Authority (sales tax vendor registration)
items.agency: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
items.note: Register at least 20 days before beginning business.

items.name: Employer registration for unemployment insurance (NYS-100)
items.agency: New York State Department of Labor
items.note: Once $300 or more in wages is paid in a quarter; FEIN needed first.

items.name: Workers' compensation and disability/PFL coverage
items.agency: New York State Workers' Compensation Board
items.condition: Insurance bought from a carrier, not a filing.

items.name: Food Service Establishment Permit
items.agency: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

items.name: Food Protection Certificate
items.agency: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
items.note: A holder must supervise food operations.

items.name: Sign permit
items.condition: Signs that are nailed, screwed or illuminated.

items.name: DOB work permit for the build-out (alteration)
items.note: "Department of Buildings work permits are required for most construction projects."

items.name: Restaurant Wine license (on-premises beer and wine)
items.feeNote: $960 license fee (2-year term, NYC counties) plus a $100 filing fee (SLA fee chart).
items.note: Restaurants must have a kitchen and a full menu.
items.match: restaurant wine|on-premises liquor license|beer and wine\)

items.name: 30-day notice to the community board
items.agency: Community board (required by the State Liquor Authority)
items.note: "notify their community board of their intention to apply for a liquor license 30 days before filing"; proof goes with the application.

items.name: Alcohol dealer registration (TTB F 5630.5d)
items.agency: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
items.note: "No person may engage in the business of selling or offering to sell distilled spirits, wine, or beer without first registering." Before engaging in business; no fee stated.

order.why: Notify the community board 30 days before filing with the SLA.
FEIN needed before the UI registration.
